title: Malicious code in dowload_ebok_ruckkehr_ins_zombieland_by_gena_showalter_constanze_suhr_8174w (npm)
description: The npm package 'dowload_ebok_ruckkehr_ins_zombieland_by_gena_showalter_constanze_suhr_8174w' contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or run.
